description: A link the person opens to ask an RYC manager to check and book one discounted boat-week. The link opens the boat page with the request form already open; the person signs in by email and presses Send — the assistant cannot send the request itself. The manager replies on the site's Messages page, by notification or email, within an hour from 10:00 to 20:00 Moscow time. Pass the id or page URL from search_deals or get_boat.

id.description: Boat-week id: the number at the end of the page URL

url.description: Boat page URL from search_deals or get_boat

name: request_availability
title: Link to request a boat
